subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference for Acme Health
messages:
From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T08:57:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood demo - Acme Health

Hi Marissa,

We just completed a self-serve signup and I wanted to reach out directly to see about scheduling a demo. We're evaluating inference platforms to reduce per-token cost and get better reliability for our production summarization pipelines.

A few quick things about us:
- Use case: Clinical chart summarization and question answering for care teams (PHI in scope)
- Expected volume: currently ~100k requests/day (bursty), about ~50M tokens/month
- Timeline: want to run a POC in Q4 and go to pilot early next year

Can we set up a 30-minute demo next week? I'm in PST. If useful, I can loop in procurement for contracting questions.

Thanks,
Alex Jones
Head of Data Science
Acme Health
alex.jones@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo - Acme Health

Hi Alex - great to meet you and congrats on the self-serve signup. Happy to run a demo and make sure we cover everything relevant for a PHI workflow. Before we lock a time, quick qualification so the demo is tailored: 

1) Data sensitivity & deployment: Will you need a private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for PHI, or can you start on hosted with a BAA?
2) Model & latency needs: Are you using an open model (e.g., Llama family) or a vendor model? Target p95 latency SLA?
3) Traffic pattern & concurrency: Is the 100k requests/day steady or spiky? Typical tokens per request?
4) Decision timeline & stakeholders: Who needs to be on the POC decision (Eng, Security, Procurement)?

Available 30-minute slots next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-08-11 10:00-10:30
- Wed 2026-08-12 14:00-14:30
- Thu 2026-08-13 09:00-09:30

If none of these work, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/invite/abc123

I've attached a short demo agenda and a pre-demo checklist to help your team prepare.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo - Acme Health

Thanks Marissa - answers below: 

1) PHI & deployment: We'll likely need a private deployment or at minimum a BAA + SOC2 evidence before moving beyond POC.
2) Model: We'll start with an open model (tuned Llama-2/3 variant) for cost control. Latency target: p95 < 300ms for single-shot summarization.
3) Traffic: Bursty - large nightly ingestion and daytime interactive traffic. Typical request ~500-800 tokens.
4) Decision/stakeholders: I'll be the technical lead; Security and Procurement will be involved for contracting 

Procurement is looped here for contracting questions - I've attached the initial questionnaire they usually send to vendors. Let us know whether you can provide SOC2 and data handling docs ahead of the demo.

Preferred demo slot: Wed 2026-08-12 14:00 PST.

Thanks,
Alex
Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-05T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo - Acme Health

Perfect - wed 14:00 PST works. I sent a calendar invite (link below) for Wed 2026-08-12 14:00-14:30 PST and included a short agenda so we can prioritize PHI controls, deployment options (hosted + BAA vs Private), and performance numbers for your traffic profile.

Pre-demo checklist (attached):
- Provide a couple of sample anonymized prompts/responses we can use in the demo (or we can demo with our reference prompt set)
- Security: we'll share our SOC2 report and a brief on how Redwood handles encryption/KMS and audit logs ahead of the call
- If procurement has specific contract redlines, feel free to upload to the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/7654321

Calendar invite: https://cal.redwood.ai/invite/abc123
Security link (SOC2): https://redwood.ai/security/soc2.pdf

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Looking forward - we'll make sure to cover performance and cost levers during the walkthrough.

Best,
Marissa
